events.title: Bread Financial Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Higher Credit Sales
events.body: BFH Q1 EPS jumps 49% y/y on strong credit sales and higher margins, with revenue growth partly offset by rising compensation costs.

events.title: BFH Q1 Deep Dive: Partner Expansion and Credit Quality Fuel Growth Amid Cautious Consumer Trends
events.body: Financial services company Bread Financial (NYSE:BFH) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q1 CY2026, with sales up 4.9% year on year to $1.02 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.18 per share was 37% above analysts’ consensus estimates
